meta.note: Synthetic form built from real recurring question types captured in sources/philadelphia-regional-and-sector-forms.md (Seybert, Barra, PAsmart, SF-424, corporate eligibility quizzes). Not a real funder. Exercises the v0.2 question-bank additions.

questions.text: Are you a 501(c)(3) public charity? Note that schools and educational institutions are ineligible.
Is your organization located in or serving our required geography?
What is your organization's total annual operating budget or expenses?
Does your target population meet our age and low-income thresholds?
Mission statement.
How is your approach new and different from existing solutions, and why is it more effective?
Why is now the right time to do this work?
What is the potential to catalyze change over the next 3, 5, and 10 years?
Please share an example that illustrates your theory of change and impact.
Which underrepresented population do you target, what barriers do they face, and how do you remove them?
Describe your employer engagement strategy and connections to jobs, apprenticeship, or career pathways.
What measurable outcomes will demonstrate progress?
What risks or limitations do you anticipate, and how will you manage them?
Why is your organization the right one to do this, and what is its capacity and past performance?
How do your leadership and staff reflect the lived experience of the people you serve?
What is your Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) and SAM.gov status?
What are the congressional and state legislative districts for the project?
How many participants will you serve and how many jobs will be created?
What is your indirect cost rate, and do you have a NICRA?
Attach your most recent audited financials or IRS Form 990.
What steps will you take to ensure equitable access and participation for those facing barriers?
